## Checklist (Definition of Done, docs/CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated; integration tests where applicable
- [ ] Input validation and error handling in place
- [ ] Authorization / ownership checks for user data (if touching user data)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or credentials in code, logs or fixtures
- [ ] Database changes ship with an Alembic migration that upgrades and downgrades cleanly
- [ ] Documentation updated (docs/, ADR for significant architectural decisions)
- [ ] CI is green
